title: Does the beacon node correctly maintain data availability consistency when a data column sidecar arrives after the block?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: receiveDataColumnSidecar in subscriber_data_column_sidecar.go handles data columns arriving after the block. The beacon chain tracks pending data availability via the dataColumnIsAvailable flag. Sidecars arriving after block registration are queued and linked to the block when all required columns are available.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Late-arriving sidecars handled via availability tracking. No consistency violation found.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Data availability state machine handles out-of-order arrival correctly.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Late-arriving sidecars correctly handled. No consistency violation.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-002: Is max_blobs_per_block correctly enforced for epoch-dependent limits?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: validateBeaconBlock in validate_beacon_blocks.go calls MaxBlobsPerBlock(blk.Slot()) to get the epoch-appropriate limit. This function returns different values based on the epoch: pre-Deneb=0, Deneb/Electra=MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK, Fulu/Fusaka uses different logic (data columns replace blobs). The slot-based computation handles fork transitions correctly.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Epoch-dependent limit correctly computed and enforced.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: MaxBlobsPerBlock is slot-based, correctly handling epoch transitions.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Epoch-dependent blob limits correctly enforced via slot-based computation.

title: Verify Block Proposer Cannot Exploit Epoch-Dependent Blob Limits

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: A block proposer attempting to include more blobs than MaxBlobsPerBlock(slot) would have their block rejected by validateBeaconBlock. The limit is enforced per-slot, preventing epoch boundary exploitation. The block is validated by all beacon nodes independently.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: No epoch limit exploitation path. validateBeaconBlock enforces slot-based limit unconditionally.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Block proposer cannot exceed per-slot blob limit. Validated independently by all nodes.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Block proposer cannot exploit epoch-dependent limits. Validation is slot-based.

title: Verify Beacon Node Epoch Derivation from Current State

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: forkWatcher derives epoch from slots.ToEpoch(currentSlot) where currentSlot is wall-clock based. Epoch derivation is not from chain head state (to prevent sync manipulation). The fork epoch is hardcoded in params.BeaconConfig(), not derived from chain state.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Epoch derived from wall-clock slot, not sync state. No manipulation.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Wall-clock epoch derivation prevents sync-state manipulation.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Epoch correctly derived from wall-clock. No state manipulation.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-002: Are blocks with zero blob KZG commitments correctly handled?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Blocks with zero blob KZG commitments are valid (empty blob transactions). validateBeaconBlock checks len(commits) > maxBlobsPerBlock but does not reject zero-commit blocks. This is the correct behavior - a block with no blobs is a normal block post-Deneb.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Zero-commitment blocks correctly accepted. No false rejection.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Zero-blob blocks are valid and processed normally.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Zero-commitment blocks correctly handled as valid.

title: Verify Block Proposer Handling: Does the block proposer correctly create zero blob KZG commitment blocks?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: process_block.go handles block processing. A block proposer creating a block with zero blob commitments produces a valid block. The beacon state processes it through ExecutionPayloadHeader and BeaconBlockBody. No mandatory non-empty blob requirement exists post-Deneb.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Zero blob block creation and processing is correct.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Block proposer correctly handles zero-blob blocks.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Zero-blob blocks correctly created and processed.

title: Verify Beacon Node Validation: Does the beacon node permit zero blob KZG commitment blocks?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: BeaconState processing in process_block.go processes blob KZG commitments as part of BeaconBlockBody. Zero-length commitment list is valid - no minimum blob count required. Beacon state transition correctly handles this case.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Zero-blob blocks permitted and processed correctly.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Beacon node correctly permits zero-blob blocks per spec.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Zero-blob blocks correctly permitted per spec.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Are DataColumnSidecarsByRange requests validated before processing?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler validates via validateDataColumnsByRange before any database query. Checks: count != 0, no overflow in start+count-1, startSlot <= currentSlot (or noop), endSlot >= minStartSlot. Also validates requestedColumns format. Invalid requests receive error response and peer downscoring.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Request validation confirmed before processing. Invalid requests rejected.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: DataColumnSidecarsByRange requests properly validated before processing.

title: Verify RPC Requester Input Validation for DataColumnSidecarsByRange

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Client-side (requester) input validation in rpc_send_request.go validates that the total requested count (count * len(columns)) does not exceed MaxRequestDataColumnSidecars before sending. Server-side validation in validateDataColumnsByRange enforces slot range bounds.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Dual-side validation: client pre-validates, server validates on receipt.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Both client and server enforce input validation.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Input validation invariant holds at both sides.
phase3_invariant_proving.guard_identified: rpc_send_request.go client validation + validateDataColumnsByRange server validation

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Input validation enforced on both client and server sides.

title: Verify Beacon Node Response Construction Enforces Dual Limit

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Response construction in dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler enforces two limits: (1) slot range via rangeParameters (from validateDataColumnsByRange), (2) total sidecar count via maxRequestDataColumnSidecars quota that decrements in streamDataColumnBatch. Dual enforcement prevents response overflow.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Dual limit enforced: slot range + total count quota. No overflow.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Dual limit prevents response size inflation from either direction.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Dual limit properly enforces response construction bounds.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Is DataColumnSidecarsByRange epoch range correctly enforced?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: validateDataColumnsByRange uses dataColumnsRPCMinValidSlot (MinEpochsForDataColumnSidecarsRequest) to compute minimum start slot. Start slot clamped to max(requested, minStartSlot). End slot clamped to min(requested_end, currentSlot). Proper epoch range enforcement.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Epoch range correctly enforced. Clamping prevents serving outside retention window.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Does DataColumnSidecarsByRange return sidecars only for canonical blocks?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: newBlockRangeBatcher uses s.cfg.chain.IsCanonical to filter blocks. Only canonical blocks are processed for sidecar streaming. This prevents serving sidecars from forked/orphaned blocks.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: IsCanonical filter confirmed. Non-canonical blocks excluded from response.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Canonical filter prevents non-canonical sidecar serving.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: DataColumnSidecarsByRange correctly serves only canonical block sidecars.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Are DataColumnSidecarsByRange peers penalized for invalid requests?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: When validateDataColumnsByRange returns error (ErrInvalidRequest), dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRPCHandler calls s.downscorePeer(remotePeer, 'dataColumnSidecarsByRangeRpcHandlerValidationError'). Transition-period requests (overshoot, below min slot) are not treated as errors (return nil rangeParameters) and do NOT trigger peer downscoring.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Penalty correctly applied for invalid requests only. No false penalization.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Peer scoring correctly distinguishes invalid from transition requests.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Peer penalties correctly applied only for genuinely invalid requests.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Is data_column_serve_range correctly derived per spec?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: dataColumnsRPCMinValidSlot (in rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_root.go) uses MinEpochsForDataColumnSidecarsRequest and FuluForkEpoch to compute minimum slot. serve_range = [max(FuluForkEpoch_start, currentEpoch - MinEpochsForDataColumnSidecarsRequest), currentSlot]. This matches the EIP-7594 specification for data column retention.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Serve range derivation confirmed correct per EIP-7594 spec.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Serve range correctly anchored to FuluForkEpoch and MinEpochsForDataColumnSidecarsRequest.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Data column serve range derivation invariant holds.

phase3_5_scope_filtering.reason: Serve range correctly derived per EIP-7594 specification.

title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-003: Does DataColumnSidecarsByRoot only serve within valid retention window?

phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: dataColumnSidecarByRootRPCHandler calls dataColumnsRPCMinValidSlot and rejects requests for slots before the minimum. Only data columns within MinEpochsForDataColumnSidecarsRequest of current slot are served. The handler uses storage.Get which only retrieves persisted (validated) sidecars.

phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Retention window enforced. Out-of-window requests rejected.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.summary: Root-based requests validated against retention window.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: Retention window invariant holds for root-based requests.
